title: A Structural SVM Based Approach for Optimizing Partial AUC

METHODS.pages: 2-6, equations 1-7, optimization problems OP1-OP6, and Algorithm 1

anchors.quote: However it turns out that by working with a restricted search space
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 方法把 pAUC 损失嵌入结构 SVM 的 cutting-plane 约束，通过限制排序矩阵搜索空间，把指数规模的最违约约束搜索化为按负样本排序后的可处理子问题。

anchors.quote: For each data set, we used random
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 信息检索实验用查询级随机切分分离训练、验证和测试，并在十次切分上汇总；其他任务也使用多次随机切分，但并未报告独立优化随机种子。

ABLATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 全文没有移除结构 SVM 组件、改变约束求解器或在相同目标下做方法组件消融；Figure 4 仅改变 FPR 区间并记录运行时间和调用次数，属于计算敏感性分析而非组件消融。

LIMITATIONS.pages: 1-9 including discussion embedded in methods, all experiments, and conclusion
LIMITATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 论文没有独立局限章节，也没有系统讨论线性模型限制、切分与训练随机性的混合、测试尾部样本量、阈值不确定性、回流曝光公平性或对 FN95 任务的外推边界。

formulas: Normalized pAUC_f(alpha,beta) is the integral of TPR_f(FPR_f^{-1}(u)) over u in [alpha,beta], divided by beta-alpha.
Empirical pAUC risk is 1 minus empirical pAUC and depends on positives paired with score-ranked negatives in the selected FPR band.
The structural SVM objective minimizes 0.5||w||^2 + C xi subject to a margin constraint for every positive-negative ordering matrix.
The partial-AUC loss Delta_pAUC compares the ground-truth ordering matrix with candidate orderings only over the target negative ranks.
The most-violated constraint maximizes the partial-AUC loss minus the model's joint-feature margin over the restricted ordering space.
algorithm_steps: Freeze the operational FPR interval [alpha,beta], form positive and negative training sets, and represent their pairwise ranking by a binary ordering matrix.
Initialize a cutting-plane structural SVM and repeatedly score negatives under the current linear parameter w.
Find the most-violated ordering constraint: use an elementwise solution for [0,beta] or Algorithm 1's per-positive three-group search for general [alpha,beta].
Add the constraint to the quadratic program and update w until the cutting-plane accuracy condition is met.
variables: m and n: positive and negative training counts
alpha and beta: frozen lower and upper false-positive rates
j_alpha and j_beta: negative-rank boundaries induced by alpha and beta
C and xi: structural-SVM regularization and slack
Delta_pAUC and phi(S,pi): partial-AUC loss and joint feature map
selection_timing: At every cutting-plane iteration, negatives are re-ranked by the current w and the target FPR band determines which pairwise order errors enter the most-violated constraint. This is model-state-dependent loss construction, not an added replay set.
refresh_rule: The active ordering constraint refreshes on each cutting-plane iteration until convergence. The operational [alpha,beta] interval remains frozen; there is no epoch-level replay schedule or persistent selected-ID pool.

budget.unit: positive-negative ranking comparisons contributing to the empirical partial-AUC loss
budget.denominator: m times n times (beta-alpha), with boundary corrections for non-integer negative ranks
budget.unique_sample_definition: Unique identities are the positive and negative training instances, but the paper does not report the union of negative IDs active across cutting-plane iterations.
budget.repeat_definition: A positive or high-ranked negative can participate in many pairwise constraints and be revisited after each re-ranking; no per-ID repeat ledger is reported.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: There is no optimizer-visible replay exposure ledger. Pairwise constraint participation changes with w and is not made comparable to uniform sampling exposure.
budget.compute_cost: The most-violated-constraint search is O((m+n) log(m+n)) with compact orderings, matching the stated complexity of full-AUC optimization; total cost also depends on cutting-plane calls, which increase as beta shrinks.

random_baselines: No global-random or method-matched-random replay selection baseline is included.
datasets: virtual-screening cheminformatics data with five targets

counts: 5 therapeutic targets times 10 random train-test splits for the cheminformatics table
10 random query-level train-validation-test splits for each information-retrieval dataset
10 random train-test splits for KDD Cup 2008
seed_count.aggregation: Means over random data splits are reported; optimization initialization seeds, per-split values, dispersion, direction counts, and worst split are not reported.

checkpoint_selection: The experiments learn linear structural-SVM solutions rather than selecting neural checkpoints. Hyperparameters and preprocessing are said to use supplementary details, and validation splits are present for IR and PPI; no test-selected checkpoint is described.

results.claim: 在化学虚拟筛选的目标 FPR 区间内，SVMpAUC 的平均局部指标高于列出的基线。
results.value: pAUC(0,0.1): SVMpAUC 65.25, SVMAUC 62.64, ASVM 63.80, pAUCBoost 43.89, greedy heuristic 8.33.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 该表支持直接优化冻结局部区间会改变该区间表现，但它没有给出训练种子稳定性或固定回流曝光对照。

results.claim: PPI 实验中局部目标方法在十次随机切分的平均 pAUC 上高于全 AUC 和其他局部基线。
results.value: pAUC(0,0.1): SVMpAUC 51.79 versus SVMAUC 39.72, ASVM 44.51, pAUCBoost 48.65, and greedy heuristic 47.33.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 结果只适用于论文的局部排序目标和数据切分，不能外推成对 FN95 有利的回流样本效用。

results.claim: 优化局部区间可能改善最左端排名而不改善较宽区间或全 AUC，呈现目标区间价值反转。
results.value: SVMpAUC versus SVMAUC is 4.58 versus 3.85 at pAUC(0,1/n_test), but 49.07 versus 50.69 at pAUC(0,0.1) and 89.23 versus 89.51 for full AUC.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 同一方法在更窄尾部占优而在较宽 pAUC 与全 AUC 不占优，说明 A 必须绑定预注册局部目标，不能用全局指标替代。

ablations: No component-removal ablation is reported; Figure 4 varies beta only to analyze most-violated-constraint time and call counts.
negative_results: On TREC10, SVMpAUC optimized for [0,0.1] is lower than SVMAUC on pAUC(0,0.1) and full AUC even though it is higher at the extreme top ranks.
The number of cutting-plane constraint calls increases as beta becomes smaller.
Dispersion, worst split, and independent optimization-seed stability are absent.
The study does not evaluate a fixed cumulative replay exposure or no-replay arm.
failure_conditions: The FPR interval is chosen after examining test behavior rather than frozen from an independent target role.
The local tail contains too few negative examples for a stable empirical rank interval.
Pairwise constraint participation is treated as if it were matched optimizer-visible replay exposure.
A local pAUC gain is generalized to full AUC, FN95, or a different operating region.
Random split averages conceal direction reversals across splits or training initializations.
limitations: All learned scoring functions are linear.
The paper reports split averages but not variance, per-split results, independent optimization seeds, or worst-case behavior.
No component ablation isolates the structural formulation from the constraint-search algorithm.
No replay denominator, unique-ID union, repeats, cumulative exposure, optimizer steps, or no-replay control is defined.
Partial AUC over an FPR interval is not the same estimand as the Stage1 FN=0..95 raw safety-frontier normalized AUC.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该论文直接说明局部 ROC 目标需要冻结区间并用与该区间一致的训练或选择方向；TREC10 中窄尾部、较宽 pAUC 与全 AUC 的相对排序并不一致，支持把 A 定义为相对独立 FN95 局部目标的方向，而不是相对全局损失或全 AUC 的方向。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 结构 SVM 优化的是主训练目标中的成对排序约束，不是固定基础训练后的有限预算 replay。论文没有 Q/R/D 顺序门控、严格匹配随机回流、current-loss、R1/R2、no-replay、相同累计实际曝光或未见 training seed 配对。因此 pAUC 表格不能当作候选样本 utility evidence，也不能证明该方法会改善 Stage1 FN95。
exclusion_reason: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON:eligible as a local-target optimization and value-reversal mechanism paper
